title: PlayerUsage
description: One player's observed role and production this season, week by week, under `usage_signals_v1` (ADR-091). OBSERVED FACTS, never a model output and never a model input: every number is arithmetic over nflverse's weekly player rows and snap counts (CC-BY 4.0) through the build's cutoff week, and nothing here may move a projection, a VORP, a rank, a tier, a Pick of the Week selection or an add count. Nothing here is derived from ffopportunity, whose CC-BY-SA publication question is open (ADR-086). One record per player rather than per league preset, because a role is the same however points are scored; the three preset-dependent quantities (fantasy points, touchdown share) are keyed by preset inside the record. A missing value is null, never zero.

share.description: A fraction of the team's total in the same game(s), 0-1 for snaps, targets and carries. Air yards can be negative on a screen, so an air-yards share may fall outside 0-1; it is published as measured.

status.description: `played`: a weekly stats row or at least one offensive snap. `bye`: his team had no game that week. `did_not_play`: his team played and he did not appear, for any reason — the product has no injury feed and says nothing about which. Every metric is null unless `played`.

snap_share.description: Share of his team's offensive snaps, from nflverse snap counts. Null when he played and no snap row bridged to him — an absence, not a zero.

air_yards_share.description: His receiving air yards over his team's receiving air yards in the same game, both from the weekly player rows. Not nflverse's own `air_yards_share` column, whose denominator is built differently; one provenance for both halves, as `target_share_to_date` already does.

fantasy_points.description: Points scored that week under each preset, by this project's scoring engine.

latest.description: The metric in his most recent appearance.

earlier.description: The metric over every earlier appearance: pooled (his total over his team's) for target, carry and air-yards share; a per-game mean for snap share and raw attempts. Null below one earlier appearance with the metric defined.

change.description: `latest - earlier`, computed from the two published (rounded) numbers so a reader who subtracts them gets exactly this. Positive: a bigger role in his latest game than before it.

role_change.description: `role_change_v1`. Null when his latest appearance has no value for the metric: the rule never falls back to an older game.

team.description: The team this player's matchup is read for: his one current roster team when nflverse's roster names exactly one, else the team of his latest appearance. The key `team_matchups.json` is joined on.

weeks.description: Every fantasy-horizon week from 1 through `through_week`, in order, one entry each — including byes and absences, so a gap in a drawn series is a published fact rather than a missing row.

fantasy_points_to_date.description: The sum of `weeks[].fantasy_points`. Agrees with `ros_tiers.points_to_date` for the same player and preset; a cross-artifact check asserts it.

touchdown_points_share.description: Points from passing, rushing and receiving touchdowns divided by fantasy points to date, per preset. A sustainability reading, not a prediction: touchdowns are the most regression-prone part of a fantasy score. Null below 10 points to date. Can exceed 1 when turnovers took points away.

dropbacks.description: Pass attempts plus sacks in the weeks nflverse published an EPA for. The denominator of the next field, published so its sample is visible.

pass_epa_per_dropback.description: nflverse passing EPA (attempts and sacks) divided by `dropbacks`. Null below 20 dropbacks. Scrambles are in neither half.
